inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: At the time of the inspection, the operation did not have a current health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Five caregiver training records were reviewed and lacked training for caring for children under 24 months, and required pre-service training, and required content training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height: At the time of the inspection, the vehicles used to transport children did not have any safety seats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: During the time of the inspection, two seesaws were observed not on any required surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: During the time of the inspection, one of the vehicles used for transportation was not equipped with an electronic alarm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: A reunification plan was not included in the emergency preparedness plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Documentation of completed emergency practice drills were not made available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures: The emergency telephone number that is on file with us was not included in the emergency preparedness plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The name and address of the alternate shelter away from the center that would be used as needed was not included in the emergency preparedness plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated CO System-Document Tests, New Battery Installation and Name of Responsible Employee: Documentation of testing of the carbon monoxide detector was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated CO System-Document Tests, New Battery Installation and Name of Responsible Employee (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Comply with court order until revoked or expired: It was determined that the operation failed to comply with the court order by incorrectly releasing a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Comply with court order until revoked or expired (26 TAC §746.4101(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post: The most recent licensing inspection is not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post (26 TAC §746.401(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: Playground maintence checklist were not avalible for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Documentation of emergency drills was not provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Telephone Numbers: Emergency telephone numbers were not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §746.401(8))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: Three out of ten children's files reviewed does not have the required vision and hearing screening.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - License: The permit is not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - License (26 TAC §746.401(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection: Documentation of aa gas leak test was not provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5405)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four out of ten children's files reviewed does not have records of immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Four out of ten children's files reviewed does not have a health statement from a health-care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: A caregiver did not know the name and age of a child who was in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement: A child enrolled in care did not have a record of an enrollment agreement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The standard was evaluated as related a DFPS investigation. As a result of the DFPS investigation it was determined that the operation did not   Demonstrate competency, good judgment when performing assigned responsibilities by leaving a child unattended on a van and dropping children off at the wrong locations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation Deficiency: As related a DFPS investigation you must notify the parents of each child attending that your child-care center has a deficiency related abuse, neglect, or exploitation standard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation Deficiency (26 TAC §746.309(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The standard was evaluated as related a DFPS investigation. As a result of the DFPS investigation it was determined that the operation did not notify licensing that a child was left inside a vehicle unattended and that a child was dropped off at the wrong location.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report: As related a DFPS investigation the permit holder and/or the employee did not report related abuse, neglect, or exploitation. An employee may not delegate the responsibility to make a report, and the operation may not require an employee to seek approval to file a report or notify them that a report was made.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §746.201(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: The standard was evaluated as related a DFPS investigation. As a result of the DFPS investigation it was determined that the operation did us prohibited punishment to a child by making child do squats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The standard was evaluated as related a DFPS investigation. As a result of the DFPS investigation it was determined that the operation is not providing the level of supervision necessary to ensure each child?s safety by not ensuring that children being dropped off are left at the correct school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: The standard was evaluated as related a DFPS investigation. As a result of the DFPS investigation it was determined that a child in care was neglected when the operation left the child on the van with no supervision for an unspecified time. Based on all information found in the DFPS investigation the operation is cited for Neglectful Supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: The standard was evaluated as related a DFPS investigation. As a result of the DFPS investigation it was determined that the operation did leave a child unattended in a vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection- Inspection unavailable must maintain documentation at operation and make available to us: Operation does not have a current Health inspection on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection- Inspection unavailable must maintain documentation at operation and make available to us (26 TAC §746.3401(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Signed affidavit from parent stating medical diagnosis and treatment conflict with religious beliefs: Out of ten children files evaulate six did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Signed affidavit from parent stating medical diagnosis and treatment conflict with religious beliefs (26 TAC §746.611(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The operation could not provide documentation of a recent fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
